name: glm-token-usage
description: Harness: coding agent with GLM and ChatGPT connections, tools and subagents.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: AI can read files and run approved commands in this workspace.

glmTokenUsage.token.description: Legacy GLM API key. Prefer AI: Configure Provider (stored in SecretStorage).

glmTokenUsage.glmBaseUrl.description: GLM base URL. For pay-as-you-go use https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4.

glmTokenUsage.glmModel.description: GLM model ID. Empty imports an existing GLM model from ~/.claude/settings.json.

glmTokenUsage.openaiModel.description: OpenAI model ID for the Responses API. Set when configuring OpenAI.

glmTokenUsage.customProtocol.description: Protocol used by the custom endpoint.

glmTokenUsage.hooks.description: User or workspace Harness hooks. Project hooks from .harness/config.json run after these hooks.

glmTokenUsage.chatPlacement.description: Open new Harness chats in the current editor group or beside it.

glmTokenUsage.attachOpenFile.description: Attach the last open workspace file as a path, or include the highlighted lines when text is selected.

glmTokenUsage.maxToolRounds.description: Maximum model/tool rounds per turn. Set 0 to disable this optional task limit (default). Stop remains available.

glmTokenUsage.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per model request.

glmTokenUsage.reasoningEffort.description: GLM reasoning effort. GLM-5.3 thinking stays enabled.

glmTokenUsage.idleCompactionMinutes.description: Opt in to a paid background summary of large idle chats. Set the number of idle minutes for your provider. Zero disables this.

glmTokenUsage.modelContextWindows.description: Context window overrides by provider/model, for example glm/glm-5.3. A window set in a saved connection takes priority.

glmTokenUsage.contextWindow.description: Usable context budget. Token estimate is heuristic and calibrated from API usage; not a tokenizer guarantee.

glmTokenUsage.turnTokenBudget.description: Per-turn token budget including subagents and compaction, using budgetAccounting. Full API token statistics are unchanged. Set 0 to disable this optional task limit (default). Stop remains available.

glmTokenUsage.turnTimeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget per turn. Set 0 to disable this optional task limit (default). Stop remains available.

glmTokenUsage.subagentMaxRounds.description: Maximum model/tool rounds per subagent. Set 0 to disable this optional task limit (default). Stop remains available.

glmTokenUsage.subagentTokenBudget.description: Per-subagent token budget using budgetAccounting. Set 0 to disable this optional task limit (default). Stop remains available.

glmTokenUsage.sandbox.description: Opt-in macOS workspace sandbox for commands: workspace/tmp writes, no network. Fails closed on unsupported platforms. Approvals still apply.

glmTokenUsage.mcpServers.description: Trusted MCP servers. Local commands start when tools are searched. Configure only servers you trust; use AI: Set MCP Token for remote auth.

glmTokenUsage.workProfile.description: Both profiles use the selected starting effort. Architecture adds structured verification and optional review.

glmTokenUsage.regressionAudit.description: Select existing tests from the diff and compare assertions before and after in approved isolated runs.

glmTokenUsage.architectureReview.description: Review Architecture-profile changes independently before completing a task.

glmTokenUsage.importClaudeIntegrations.description: Discover Claude user/project MCP configurations and user/project/enabled-plugin skills. Does not copy OAuth sessions or execute hooks. Unapproved project servers require explicit connection approval.

glmTokenUsage.promptStyle.description: Compact core with on-demand workflows; detailed remains available for comparison. Small synthetic pilot supports lower token usage, not model parity.

glmTokenUsage.toolProfile.description: Lean loads more tools through search_tools. Independent of prompt/effort for controlled evaluation.

glmTokenUsage.effortPolicy.description: Adaptive allows model-selected effort. Fixed preserves the configured effort for controlled measurements.

glmTokenUsage.bundledSkills.description: Discover bundled architecture, task continuity and acceptance workflows. Contents load on demand; project skills override bundled versions.

glmTokenUsage.budgetAccounting.description: Token budget accounting for main and subagents. Uncached excludes provider-reported cached input repetitions; total counts every input/output token. Usage statistics always retain full API usage.
